summary: Reworked the activity window: Deletions tab, tab icons, fixed-color icons and uniform background.
changelog: Added a Deletions tab to the activity window with the deletion-review list and Approve/Restore actions, plus an empty state (issue #118).
Tabs now carry icons (message-circle-check, copy-x, broom-sparkles); activity and conflict rows use fixed-color icons.
Removed the redundant Close button and repeated summary label; lists are clamped for a uniform background.
